reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I’ve probably bought 25-30 Roku devices over the last several years, maintained an active account with Roku and generally have if not great things to say about the company and their brand, I at least don’t have bad things to say. However the audacity to want to charge me for the remote app for my phone is a slap in the face. When you spend at least $1000 cumulative with them there should be an unlimited use upgrade to the app that removes ads when you need to use your phone because the 5 year old remote quit working and you need to change a channe or cut the tv off
